The same survey also found that, for the first time in nearly a decade of its polling series, voters perceive the Democratic Party as having a better plan for the economy than the Republican Party. results.content: # Florida 11th Congressional District 2026: Latest Polls. ## Democratic primary polls. Republicans are entering the 2026 midterms with a 217-212 majority in the House, with five seats currently vacant and one independent. All 435 seats are up for election, but with maps continuing to shift because of redistricting, the Cook Political Report rates only 18 districts as tossups and another 19 as leaning toward one party. To retake the majority, Democrats would most likely need to hold all of their solid and likely seats, sweep those leaning their way, and flip 13 of the 18 tossups — a narrow but possible path given that the party out of power typically gains ground in the midterms. results.content:
Among registered voters, Democrats led the generic congressional ballot 42 percent to 37 percent. Independents favored Democratic candidates by 12 points.

Reuters/Ipsos surveyed 4,505 U.S. adults nationwide online July 30-August 3. The poll had a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

## Competitive Districts Show Similar Pattern

New analysis from Economist/YouGov suggested Democratic strength extends beyond heavily blue districts. [...] Nationally, registered voters favored Democrats over Republicans by 4 percentage points. More importantly for control of the House, voters in the 65 most competitive congressional districts preferred Democrats 45 percent to 40 percent, YouGov said.
